Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning actions for trespass upon a business owner's premises.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to actions for trespass upon a business owner'spremises; adding a new section to chapter 4.24 RCW; and prescribingpenalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A business owner has a cause of action for trespass against anyperson who intentionally enters or remains unlawfully upon the businessowner's premises in violation of a written notice, provided by thebusiness owner to the person, notifying the person that: (a) He or sheis prohibited from reentering the premises; and (b) any reentry of theperson onto the premises in violation of the notice constitutestrespass and is subject to the penalty established in this section. (2) In any action under subsection (1) of this section, a businessowner may recover actual damages, or elect to recover statutory damagesin the amount of two hundred fifty dollars.
